title: Book Three · Chapter 80: Tuesday Until Five
story:
On Monday, Dad brings home the new work sheet.

The four weeks are finished. Mr Sun has more jobs waiting now. Dad will work until five on Tuesdays again. Thursdays will still end at two for the next month.

“One afternoon back,” Mum says.

Dad nods. “We will look at the hours again next month.”

They put the sheet beside the household page. Some money can go back to the usual costs. The tool on Dad's list will still wait.

Ronan reads the two days. Dad's name is still beside both.

On Tuesday, Ronan passes Mr Sun's place after school. He has a question about a box at home, but he does not expect Dad at the gate.

Through the open front, he sees a customer test a wooden drawer. The man pulls it out, then pushes it back.

It slides quietly. Dad points to the new wooden edge inside.

Ronan waits near the counter. Mr Sun is writing down the job. He looks up and recognises him.

“Your father is nearly finished with this one.”

Dad sees Ronan and lifts a hand. He stays with the customer. The man checks the last drawer.

Then Dad comes over.

“Everything all right?”

“Yes. A box question. It can wait.”

Dad looks at the school bag.

“Work first?”

“Some of it. I will be home.”

Ronan takes the quiet road back. Mum is fitting a coat when he arrives. He leaves her room at the window and opens his book at the other end of the table.

Dad comes home after five. He washes, then looks at the small storage box Ronan has put near the door.

The lid sticks because a loose paper is caught at the back. Ronan takes it out. There is no broken part to replace.

“My repair,” he says.

“A whole sheet of paper,” Dad answers.

They laugh. Dad puts his work sheet away and sits down beside Mum.

After dinner, the two adults check the month's costs again. The one longer afternoon helps. It does not turn their envelopes into large piles of money.

Mum leaves her cushion on her own chair. Dad chooses the other one and stretches his legs.

“A full Tuesday,” he says.

Ronan looks up from the box. “A short Thursday still.”

“This month.”

Dad takes his cup into the yard. Mum goes back to the last few stitches of her work. Ronan puts the loose paper into his notebook and shuts the lid without a sound.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

recognise＝认出；drawer＝抽屉；storage box＝收纳盒；stretch one's legs＝伸展双腿。

## 理解问题

1. 四周后，Dad哪一天恢复较长工时？哪一天仍短些，何时再复看？
2. 家庭收入变化是否完全解决了所有开销？Ronan的小箱子实际卡在哪里？

## 读句子

**The man checks the last drawer.**

拆开看：The man / checks / the last drawer.

那位顾客／检查了／最后一个抽屉。
